subject: SOC2 re-attestation and retention policy revision — renewal amendment discussion
messages:
From: Lisa Carroll <lisa.carroll@dravishealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal: SOC2 re-attestation, retention window & capacity change

Hi Sofia,

We’re starting renewal planning for our account (current term expires 2027-01-15) and there are three items we need to align on before the renewal can proceed: 1) SOC2 re-attestation checklist and proof timeline, 2) audit log retention window (we need to decide between 365 vs 730 days for our risk team), and 3) expected throughput increases for Q1 (we anticipate a +30-45% token volume spike).

Can your team provide a proposed evidence handoff plan (who delivers what and when), a short pricing delta for the two retention options, and an initial estimate for a capacity bump (temporary burst vs reserved capacity)? We’d like to present to procurement next week.

Thanks — appreciate a concise plan we can circulate.

Lisa Carroll
Director, Information Security
Dravis Health
lisa.carroll@dravishealth.com
+1 415 555 0192

Attachments: none

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Carroll <lisa.carroll@dravishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC2 re-attestation, retention window & capacity change

Hi Lisa — thanks for the summary and signal on timing. High level response and proposed next steps below; I’ll follow with a short slide and an evidence matrix.

Summary (high level):
- SOC2 re-attestation: Redwood can provide a scoped re-attestation that includes new controls mapping and evidence snapshots for the audit period. We propose a two-week evidence collection sprint + 1-week OSAT (internal review) so you have artifacts by 2026-12-15 for your auditor.
- Retention windows: Options and delta pricing (ballpark): 365 days (no change in baseline) vs 730 days (+8% monthly contract fee) — retention affects storage + export costs. We’ll surface precise numbers once we have your monthly log volume.
- Capacity: recommend reserved uplift for critical path (add 2 dedicated vGPU nodes) and an on-demand burst pool (up to 50% throughput for 2 weeks) to handle Q1 spike. We can size final numbers after a short traffic sample.

Action items I suggest:
1) I’ll drop the SOC2 evidence matrix (spreadsheet) and a retention-options PDF into the shared Drive by EOD.
2) Ben — can you draft a short amendment summary (pricing + term options) we can show procurement?
3) Lisa/Tim — can you confirm whether you prefer 365 or 730 days for audit logs and share an example monthly log volume (GB) so we can firm up price?
4) Target: sign amendment and have evidence bulk-upload scheduled by 2026-12-15.

I’ve attached the evidence matrix and the retention-options summary for review.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-matrix.xlsx, retention-window-options.pdf

From: Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@dravishealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Carroll <lisa.carroll@dravishealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC2 re-attestation, retention window & capacity change

Sofia — quick answers from our side:
- Retention: 365 days is preferred by legal, but security is pushing for 730. Can you show both with concrete cost deltas? Procurement will likely accept 365 if the SOC2 attestation cadence is tightened.
- Monthly log volume: roughly 1.2 TB/day right now (we’ll export a sample).
- Capacity: we want the guaranteed reserved uplift for a 45% steady increase rather than a short burst; Q1 traffic profile indicates prolonged higher throughput for at least 4–6 weeks.

Also, we’d like a brief demo of the evidence upload workflow and the bulk transfer (S3 + signed URL) process — can you schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with engineering? Prefer slot tomorrow 11–11:30 PT if possible.

Thanks,
Tim Nguyen
Engineering Manager, Platform Security
Dravis Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Carroll <lisa.carroll@dravishealth.com>, Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@dravishealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC2 re-attestation, retention window & capacity change

Hi Lisa/Tim — looping in pricing/legal summary and a recommended commercial path so procurement has something concrete. Quick summary and ask from Redwood: please review and confirm so we can build the amendment.

Proposed commercial terms (draft):
- Term: extend to 24 months from current renewal date (effective 2027-01-15) — net effect: 2027-01-15 to 2029-01-14.
- Pricing: 12% credit across monthly usage for 24-month commit (in exchange for longer term).
- Retention: two options appended to amendment: 365 days (baseline, no change) or 730 days (+8% ARR uplift). Final price to be modelled on 1.2 TB/day sample.
- Capacity uplift: convert requested +45% sustained throughput to "Reserved Uplift Plan" = +2 dedicated GPU nodes (NVIDIA H100 class equivalent) with autoscale cushion. One-time provisioning fee: $X (will be itemized), monthly reserved fee: $Y (we’ll quantify after traffic sample).
- Seat/uplift add-on: optional 20-seat managed-observability bundle recommended for SOC2 reporting: $Z/month.

Attachments: I attached an amendment summary draft (amendment-summary-draft.docx) and included a link to the DocuSign envelope for the amendment. If procurement is comfortable, we can get signature and schedule the evidence upload window (we’ll provide an S3 signed URL + ingestion playbook).

Next asks:
- Lisa/Tim: confirm retention option (365 vs 730) and accept the 24-month term at a high level.
- Sofia: please schedule the evidence-upload demo tomorrow at 11 PT with Dravis engineering.
- Kimberly: can you flag any legal clauses we should pre-clear (data residency / KMS/HSM references)?

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: amendment-summary-draft.docx
Links: https://www.docusign.com/contract/D-2026-2106/amend

From: Lisa Carroll <lisa.carroll@dravishealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tim Nguyen <tim.nguyen@dravishealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: SOC2 re-attestation, retention window & capacity change

All — thanks for the fast turnaround. We’re aligned to: 24-month term, 365-day retention (we’ll treat 730 as optional pending legal signoff), and move forward with the Reserved Uplift Plan (Ben: please provide the line-item numbers by end of day PST so procurement can model).

Tim and I will join the evidence-upload demo tomorrow at 11 PT. We’ll also drop the 7-day traffic export into the shared Drive for sizing. If you can get the amendment to DocuSign with provisional numbers, procurement will queue it for legal review.

Lisa

---
Lisa Carroll
Director, Information Security, Dravis Health
